_schema.purpose: Single source of truth for every URL the research agent is allowed to fetch. Skill loads this and passes via idea_context.sourcesWhitelist; agent uses it for trusted_sources_only=true enforcement, Phase 0 lineup discovery, Phase 1+2+3 mining, and per-model fallback. Tier weights drive trustScore (I=1.0, S=0.7, C=0.4, U=never-written).

structure.vendors: Per-vendor URL bundles. tier='S' (vendor self-report). Used by both Phase 0 lineup discovery (urls.lineup) and per-model S-tier fallback (urls.news/docs/pricing).
structure.leaderboards: Independent benchmark sources. tier='I'. Used by Phase 1 mining.
structure.aggregators: Multi-provider inference catalogs. tier='I'. Used by Phase 2 multi-provider pricing mining.
structure.local: Local-runtime catalogs (Ollama, Unsloth, quants). tier='I'. Used per-model when tier='ollama' or vramRequirement is sought.
structure.registries: Model metadata registries (HF leaderboard, llmfit). tier='I'.
structure.community: Aggregator blogs / expert commentary. tier='C'. Used only when no I/S source carries the value.
structure.complianceAggregators: Vendor-agnostic compliance/audit registries. tier='I' (independent). Used by privacy/compliance survey for SOC2/HIPAA/ISO/GDPR verification — independent override over vendor self-report.

perEntryFields.format: One of formatTaxonomy keys (default static_html_table). Drives adapter selection.
perEntryFields.extractor: One of extractors keys (default inferred from format).
perEntryFields.fallbacks: Ordered cascade [{format, urlPattern?}]. Walked on primary failure before gaps[].
perEntryFields.tierOverride: Domain-tier override for WebSearch results (string I|S|C).
perEntryFields.imageOCRPatterns: Vendor-only regex strings; URL match triggers scripts/extract-images.py.
perEntryFields.lastVerifiedDate: ISO date URL last verified reachable.
perEntryFields.publishes: Array of bench keys this leaderboard publishes. Two shapes accepted (P10.4 reform): legacy string list ['swePro','sweV',...] OR object list [{key:'swePro',priority:'primary'},...]. Priority drives Phase 3 cascade order (primary → secondary → tertiary → WebSearch fallback). scripts/lib/whitelist.py normalizes both shapes.

_schema._benchKeyNotes: cfElo stores RAW Codeforces ELO (range 0-3500); webDevElo stores RAW LMArena WebDev Arena Elo (range 950-1300 typical, allowed up to 1500); every other bench key stores 0-100 percentage. compositeScore() in assets/js/data.js normalizes cfElo and webDevElo via core.js normalizeBenchScore() (linear map to 0-100) before weighting. audit-data-coherence.py allows cfElo cells in [0, 3500] and webDevElo cells in [0, 1500].
_schema.benchKeysUsage: Universe of bench keys = coreBenchKeys ∪ leaderboards[].publishes[]. New leaderboards extending publishes[] auto-extend the universe. Frontend BENCH_KEYS in assets/js/core.js mirrors coreBenchKeys; if you add a new core key here, add it to assets/js/core.js too. NOTE 2026-04-29: dropped `aider` (Aider Polyglot leaderboard frozen 2025-08; no Opus 4.7 / Gemini 3.1 Pro / GPT-5.5 entries). Renamed `lcbV6` → `lcb` (rolling LiveCodeBench leaderboard supersedes pinned v6). Added: `tbHard`, `cfElo`, `mmluPro`, `simpleQa`, `mrcr`, `arcAgi2`, `browseComp` — all with strong 2026 vendor adoption.

static_html_article.description: Long-form article with inline numeric mentions

static_markdown.description: Vendor blog with markdown tables (Qwen blog, Mistral news)

static_json_api.description: Pure JSON endpoint (HF Datasets API, GitHub Releases)

spa_partial.description: SPA shell with extractable static sub-pages or embedded JSON-LD

spa_full.description: Full SPA, no static fallback (BFCL, LiveCodeBench, MathArena)

meta_tag_extract.description: SEO meta + JSON-LD scores (top-3 typically) — fetches the SPA URL but extracts only static head content

image_embedded.description: Vendor announcement with bench tables as PNG (anthropic.com/news, deepmind.google/models)

websearch_snippet.description: WebSearch query + tier-assign per result domain (terminal fallback)

regex_extract.description: Bench-alias-table run over plain text (cleanup → patterns)

image_ocr.description: Orchestrator-side script + vision read; agent never directly handles images

websearch_snippet.description: Query + tier-assign per result domain (per WEBSEARCH_PRIMARY_DISCIPLINE)

regexLibrary._purpose: SSOT for all extraction patterns. Agent NEVER inlines a regex; references by name only. Patterns audited for ReDoS + Unicode + locale tolerance via scripts/regex-lint.js against scripts/regex-corpus.json. Regex syntax is ECMAScript; embed-here uses JSON-escaped backslashes.
regexLibrary._localeDecimalRule: If captured number contains both '.' and ',': last occurrence is decimal, other is thousands (strip). Only ',': /^\d{1,3},\d{3}(,\d{3})*$/ → thousands form (strip); else decimal (replace ',' with '.'). Handles 87.6, 87,6, 1,234.56, 1.234,56, 1 234,56.

DASH_CLASS.description: 9 Unicode dash variants (hyphen-minus, hyphen, NB-hyphen, figure dash, en/em dash, horizontal bar, minus sign, small/full-width hyphen)

WHITESPACE_CLASS.description: Whitespace incl NBSP, thin-space, narrow-no-break-space, figure-space — BIPM thousands separator coverage

EMPTY_PLACEHOLDER.description: Recognized non-numeric cells; row matched but value emitted as null

LATIN_DIGITS.description: Latin digits only; non-Latin numerals (Arabic-Indic/Thai/Devanagari) get C-tier WebSearch fallback

bench_score_labeled.description: Bench name + score in same span. Bounded paren content (max 40c), Unicode dashes, decimal locale-tolerant, optional unit, version suffix v1..v99. Most-common pattern.

bench_score_table_row.description: HTML table row; bounded inner cell count (1-30) and cell length (0-200c). Pass-2 row split, pass-3 cell value walk paired with row-first cell as model anchor.

bench_score_uncertainty.description: '87.6 ± 0.3' or '87.6±0.3'. Symmetric uncertainty; primary value isolated, sigma captured.

bench_score_range.description: '85-90' → max captured; agent picks max for ranges, logs delta to gaps[].

bench_score_normalized_0_1.description: '0.876' → multiply ×100. Only when bench typically reports 0-100 per benchSchema hint; guard against confidence-interval false positives.

pricing_per_million.description: '$5.00 / 1M tokens', '$0.20/M'. Optional space, optional '1' prefix, plural-tolerant.

pricing_input_output_pair.description: '$3 in / $15 out'. Direction labels; optional second '$'.

pricing_subscription_tier.description: 'Pro tier $20/mo'. Unicode-safe casing; common tier names.

vendor_lineup_active_id.description: Model id under 'active models' / 'current' heading. Code-fenced ids; semver-like; min 2 letters at start (rejects 'v1.0' false-positives) and tolerates trailing alpha suffix like '-pro' / '-mini'.

next_image_proxy_url.description: Next.js _next/image proxy URL — URL-decode in post-process.

markdown_table_row.description: Pipe-separated row; bounded cell count (1-30) and cell length (1-200c). Post-process rejects separator rows matching ^\|[\s\-:]+\|.

meta_description_score.description: <meta name=description content=...> — then run bench_score_labeled over content. Catches SPA top-N scores in head.

jsonld_score_field.description: <script type=application/ld+json>...</script> — JSON-parse and walk for aggregateRating, score, value, mainEntity.score numeric fields.

perModelExpansion.description: Cascade discovery: when leaderboard aggregate has sparse cells for a model, agent attempts perModelUrlTemplate using slugVariations against model.id. Each {id} in a variation is replaced with the model.id. {family} = model.id with version suffix stripped (e.g., grok-3-mini → grok). {N} = numeric major version. {YYMMDD} = released-date condensed. {variant} = vendor-specific subfamily token (pro/flash/lite).

fields.perModelUrlTemplate: URL with {slug} placeholder for per-model page
fields.perModelFormat: Format key for per-model page (may differ from leaderboard format)
fields.slugVariations: Ordered array of slug variants to try; first 200 wins
fields.postUrlPattern: Vendor blog post URL pattern; agent uses postSlugVariations

cascadeOrder: 2. perModelUrlTemplate × slugVariations (NEW; for entries that have one)

contracts._purpose: SSOT for every threshold, retry count, and pass/fail criterion the skill + agent + scripts share. SKILL.md/agent.md reference this block rather than mirroring values; merge.py + audit-* scripts fetch via scripts/lib/whitelist.py contracts().

notApplicableRules._retired: N/A retired 2026-05-26 — every (model, bench) cell is FILLED or GAP; the agent emits no notApplicable and gap-gen turns unmeasured cells into gaps (freshness-skip only).

benchAliases._purpose: Canonical bench-key ↔ human-name mapping. Agent extraction maps scraped names back to canonical keys via this table — replaces the hardcoded EXTRACTION_DISCIPLINE row 5 table.

huggingfaceExtraction._purpose: HF model card README scraping protocol — Phase 2 PER_MODEL_URL_EXPANSION priority chain
fetchOrder: 1. hfApi: GET /api/models/{org}/{slug} → JSON: {modelId, lastModified, downloads, likes, tags, library_name}
2. hfReadme: GET /<org>/<slug>/raw/main/README.md → markdown → bench table extraction
3. hfModelCard: HTML fallback if README absent or empty

_schema._deprecatedBenchKeysNote: FAZ 5.B/C 2026-05-09 split bench universe from 26 → 10 core keys. These 16 legacy keys still hold values in data/models.json (preserved for historical accuracy) but are no longer refreshed by gather agents and not surfaced in priorityCells. Audit accepts them as 'deprecated' rather than 'unknown'. Front-end may render them in a 'historical' section or hide entirely.

normalization._purpose: Per-bench normalize to [0,100] composite scale. Loaded by assets/js/core.js normalizeBenchScore() with backward-compat fallback to hardcoded literals. Adding a new ELO-scale bench = data PR only.

aaOmni._note: AA Omniscience: lower is better; inverted so higher composite = better

confidence._purpose: Parameters for cellConfidence() haircut in assets/js/data.js. Each cell's contribution to composite scales by verif * trust * (1 - penalty).
confidence._penaltyNote: delta < CONTRADICTION_WARN_PP → 0 penalty; delta >= CONTRADICTION_WARN_PP → 0.15; delta >= CONTRADICTION_BLOCK_PP → 0.40
confidence._fallbackTrustNote: Used when max trustScore = 0 (e.g., source has no trustScore field yet)
confidence._pseudoSourcesNote: These source names are non-evidentiary (extraction hints, not real provenance). Excluded from urls.size + trustScore aggregation. Same list also used by scripts/purge-pseudo-sources.py.

benchKind._purpose: Classify each bench key. Atomic = single-test methodology, single publisher. VendorComposite = aggregate-of-benches by external publisher (their own weighting). AICoderMap composite uses ONLY atomic; vendor composites surface in cross-validation panel.
benchKind._rule: If bench X's score is a function of OTHER benches' scores (by an external publisher's weighting), it's vendorComposite. Single-bench aggregates like Elo (head-to-head matches within ONE eval) stay atomic.

vendorComposites._purpose: Metadata for vendor-aggregated composite benches. Used by UI cross-validation panel + 'AA says X' tooltips. NOT included in AICoderMap composite weighting (would cause double-counting since componentBenches are already weighted atomically).

aaIdx.label: AA Intelligence Index
aaIdx._componentNote: Approximate — AA may add/remove components per index revision; sciCode + aiderPoly not in our coreBenchKeys

composite._purpose: Policy parameters for AICoderMap composite score formula.
composite._coverageShrinkageNote: composite = raw * (coverage ^ (1/exponent)). 2 = sqrt (current behavior). >2 = gentler penalty for low coverage. 1 = linear. 0 = no penalty.

imputation._disabledNote: Enabled 2026-05-18. effectiveScore() dispatches to compositeScoreImputed which fills missing imputable benches with peer-tier median (≥3 peers, normalized via _schema.normalization). Imputed cells weighted at imputedConfidenceFactor (0.5); total imputed share capped at maxImputedWeightShare (0.30).

composite._minCoverageDisplayNote: Models below this fraction of preset coverage get 'limited data' UI badge.

presets._purpose: Data-driven preset definitions. assets/js/core.js PRESETS literal loads from here with backward-compat fallback. 'consensus' preset is new — uses vendor composite median rather than atomic weighting. Per-preset tiered bench classification (required/critical/imputable) drives missing-data UI policy in data.js + render-card.js.

consensus.description: Mean rank across all 10 vendor composites (AA family + LLM-Stats + Vellum + BenchLM + LMArena + HuggingFace + Klu). Coverage-penalized: a model with only 1 of 10 vendor composites cannot outrank a model with 5.

balanced._atomicNote: Rebalanced 2026-05-18 to sum to 100. Atomic-only (vendor composites moved to vendorCompositeView).

benchmark-only._atomicNote: Rebalanced 2026-05-18 to sum to 100. Atomic-only (vendor composites moved to vendorCompositeView).

benchVerificationStrict._purpose: Per-bench stricter verification thresholds for cells that have historically attracted hallucinated provenance. Audit's MX6 rule and agent's per-cell verification both consult this map.

lowConfidenceUrls._purpose: Root-listing URLs (whole-leaderboard pages) prone to cross-row misattribution. Agent fetch returns rendered HTML with all models × all benchmarks, but extracting a specific (modelId, benchKey) cell from such a listing is error-prone. trustScore is multiplied by trustPenaltyMultiplier (default 0.5) when a citation's URL matches one of these patterns. Specific bench-path URLs (e.g. https://llm-stats.com/benchmarks/livecodebench) are NOT penalized — they unambiguously identify the bench.
